exact.式 (2) 中下標 $t-a$ 的「負號」正是翻轉（$-a$ 方向反轉），再加上: In Eq. (2), the "minus sign" in the index $t-a$ is exactly the flip (the $-a$ direction is reversed), and adding $t$ then shifts it. If it were changed to $w[t+a]$, it would be only a shift with no flip, which becomes the one-dimensional version of cross-correlation.
exact.式 (3) 中 $K[i-m, j-n]$ 的「$i-m$」和「$j-n$」分別: In Eq. (3), the "$i-m$" and "$j-n$" in $K[i-m, j-n]$ flip along the row and column directions respectively; this is the core definition of 2D discrete convolution. If it were changed to $K[m-i, n-j]$, it would become cross-correlation (Eq. (4)).
exact.名字叫「卷積」，但底層執行的是互相關（不翻核）。這是深度學習框架的歷史慣例，學術: is called "convolution", but underneath it computes cross-correlation (no kernel flip). This is a historical convention of deep learning frameworks, and academia has widely accepted this naming inconsistency.
exact.可學習核在訓練開始時是隨機初始化的。梯度下降只關心如何讓損失函式下降，不關心慣例: A learnable kernel is randomly initialized at the start of training. Gradient descent only cares about how to make the loss function decrease, not whether the convention is convolution or cross-correlation. Train with cross-correlation and the kernel automatically learns "the correct kernel, unflipped"; train with convolution and it learns "the correct kernel, flipped". The end result is equivalent.
exact.✅ 兩者輸出相同！（核是對稱的，翻轉後等於自身）: ✅ The two outputs are identical! (The kernel is symmetric: flipping it gives itself.)
exact.⚠ 兩者輸出不同！（非對稱核，翻轉後結果有差）: ⚠ The two outputs differ! (An asymmetric kernel: flipping it changes the result.)

9c52d2305c70.zh: 離散卷積與互相關 Discrete Convolution and Cross-Correlation

537be7b6057d.zh: 卷積是深度學習影像處理的核心運算。理論定義要先翻轉核再滑動相乘；實務CNN則省略翻轉，改做互相關（cross-correlation）。兩者只差一個映象翻轉，訓練時梯度下降會自動適配，讓網路學到正確的特徵方向。
537be7b6057d.en: Convolution is the core operation of image processing in deep learning. The theoretical definition first flips the kernel and then slides and multiplies; practical CNNs skip the flip and compute cross-correlation instead. The two differ only by a mirror flip, and during training gradient descent adapts automatically, so the network learns the correct feature orientation.

878fafed492c.zh:
「翻核再蓋印 vs 直接蓋印，結果會不同嗎？」 理論卷積先把核沿軸翻過來、再做乘加；CNN框架通常直接蓋印（互相關）省略翻轉。
Convolution flips the kernel; cross-correlation doesn't — but training learns either way.
878fafed492c.en:
“Flip the kernel and then stamp, or stamp directly: is the result different?”
      <small>Theoretical convolution first flips the kernel along its axes and then multiplies and adds; CNN frameworks usually stamp directly (cross-correlation) and skip the flip.</small>

910f8beef962.en: For a 1-D signal $x[a]$ and a kernel $w$, the convolution output at time $t$ is defined as:

關鍵：下標 $t-a$ = 翻轉 + 平移
$w[t-a]$ 中的 $t-a$，拆開來看：
9bdf9b15c3a0.en:
Key: the index $t-a$ = flip + shift
Break down the $t-a$ in $w[t-a]$:

3bf5b670271e.zh: $-a$（翻轉）：把核沿時間軸鏡射，$w[a] \to w[-a]$。
3bf5b670271e.en: $-a$ (flip): mirror the kernel along the time axis, $w[a] \to w[-a]$.

6baf055a5edf.zh: $+t$（平移）：再把翻過的核滑到位置 $t$，$w[-a] \to w[t-a]$。
6baf055a5edf.en: $+t$ (shift): then slide the flipped kernel to position $t$, $w[-a] \to w[t-a]$.

eab519a91e84.zh: 物理直覺：核先翻轉，再像印章一樣滑過訊號
eab519a91e84.en: Physical intuition: the kernel is flipped first, then slides over the signal like a stamp

2627ecd36d61.zh: 想像核是一個「翻轉的模板」：先把模板對折（翻轉），再從左往右逐格蓋印（相乘累加），每個輸出格子等於「模板疊在那個位置時，各格乘積之和」。 Think of the kernel as a flipped stamp: first mirror it, then slide it across the signal. Each output is the dot product of the (flipped) kernel with the overlapping input region.
2627ecd36d61.en: Think of the kernel as a “flipped template”: first fold the template over (flip it), then stamp it cell by cell from left to right (multiply and accumulate). Each output cell equals “the sum of the cell-wise products when the template is laid over that position”.

6be4f914d1e8.zh: 二維影像卷積：式 (3) 與求和範圍 2-D Image Convolution: Equation (3) and Summation Range

36f64ff78163.en: For an image $I$ and a kernel $K$, the convolution output at position $(i, j)$ is defined as:

f62934b99c55.zh: 求和範圍：理論上是 $(-\infty, +\infty)$，實務上只加核蓋得到的那些格子（核邊長決定有效範圍）。
f62934b99c55.en: Summation range: in theory it is $(-\infty, +\infty)$; in practice we only add the cells the kernel covers (the kernel's side length sets the effective range).

7eaf0c7f4c0d.zh: 二維卷積示意：影像 I（左）與核 K（中）及輸出 s（右）
7eaf0c7f4c0d.en: 2-D convolution: image I (left), kernel K (middle) and output s (right)

b1edc79c93a7.zh: K[i-m, j-n] 中的減法 = 兩個維度都要翻轉！
b1edc79c93a7.en: The subtraction in K[i-m, j-n] = flip in both dimensions!

a774308da954.zh: 理論求和範圍：$m, n \in (-\infty, +\infty)$，但影像邊界外的畫素視為 0（zero-padding）。
a774308da954.en: Theoretical summation range: $m, n \in (-\infty, +\infty)$, but pixels outside the image border are treated as 0 (zero-padding).

0d5ebfad4ed4.zh: 實務有效格子：只有核能完整蓋住的區域才有有效輸出。核大小 $k \times k$，影像大小 $H \times W$，有效輸出大小 $(H-k+1) \times (W-k+1)$。
0d5ebfad4ed4.en: Effective cells in practice: only regions the kernel can fully cover produce a valid output. With kernel size $k \times k$ and image size $H \times W$, the valid output size is $(H-k+1) \times (W-k+1)$.

a0a3402b1851.en: Theory flips the kernel; practical CNNs usually don't

507a2eee39a3.zh: 下標 $K[i-m, j-n]$ 中的「減」代表翻轉。
507a2eee39a3.en: The “minus” in the index $K[i-m, j-n]$ stands for the flip.

5b98e0e28c50.zh: 滿足交換律：$f * g = g * f$（訊號處理的重要性質）。
5b98e0e28c50.en: Commutative: $f * g = g * f$ (an important property in signal processing).

60976e639e3d.zh: 理論上嚴謹，Fourier 域乘法對應真卷積。
60976e639e3d.en: Theoretically rigorous: multiplication in the Fourier domain corresponds to true convolution.

ab612d34410b.zh: 下標 $K[m-i, n-j]$ 中的「正號」代表直接蓋上去，不翻轉。
ab612d34410b.en: The “plus sign” in the index $K[m-i, n-j]$ means the kernel is laid on directly, without flipping.

1b18ebe4d7cd.zh: 不滿足交換律，但效能等同（只差映象）。
1b18ebe4d7cd.en: Not commutative, but equally effective (they differ only by a mirror image).

ae5083a1fb6e.zh: PyTorch F.conv2d、TensorFlow tf.nn.conv2d 實際上都做互相關。
ae5083a1fb6e.en: PyTorch F.conv2d and TensorFlow tf.nn.conv2d both actually compute cross-correlation.

b33f5d9cd692.zh: 符號：$I \star K$，使用星形符號 ⋆ (U+22C6)。
b33f5d9cd692.en: Notation: $I \star K$, using the star operator ⋆ (U+22C6).

94190fbfe4d9.zh: 雖然 PyTorch 的函式叫做 F.conv2d（卷積），但它實際執行的是互相關（cross-correlation），不翻核。這是歷史慣例造成的命名混淆。學術論文裡寫「卷積層」，程式裡幾乎都在做互相關。
94190fbfe4d9.en: Although PyTorch's function is called F.conv2d (convolution), what it actually computes is cross-correlation, without flipping the kernel. This naming confusion comes from historical convention. Academic papers write “convolutional layer”, and almost all code computes cross-correlation.

48eff2ce533a.zh: 互相關正式定義：式 (4) Cross-Correlation: Equation (4)

c497bb799b3a.zh: 式 (4)：二維互相關（k 為核邊長）
c497bb799b3a.en: Equation (4): 2-D cross-correlation (k is the kernel's side length)

e126feb4e9ad.zh: 式 (3)（卷積）：$K[i-m, j-n]$，下標「$i-m$」，先翻轉再平移。
e126feb4e9ad.en: Equation (3) (convolution): $K[i-m, j-n]$, index “$i-m$”: flip first, then shift.

57c78c7c6e0a.zh: 式 (4)（互相關）：$K[m-i, n-j]$，下標「$m-i$」，直接平移，無翻轉。
57c78c7c6e0a.en: Equation (4) (cross-correlation): $K[m-i, n-j]$, index “$m-i$”: shift directly, no flip.

7ac25ca0d043.zh: 求和上限 $k$：代表核邊長（核大小 $k \times k$）。
7ac25ca0d043.en: Upper summation limit $k$: the kernel's side length (kernel size $k \times k$).

9ea0e2d0febb.zh:
卷積：$I * K$（星號 *）
互相關：$I \star K$（⋆，U+22C6）
兩者只差核的方向，不差運算的本質。
9ea0e2d0febb.en:
Convolution: $I * K$ (asterisk *)
Cross-correlation: $I \star K$ (⋆, U+22C6)
The two differ only in the kernel's orientation, not in the nature of the operation.

e70ac924270f.zh: 式 (4) 顯式地用核邊長 $k$ 做上限，精確限定了滑動視窗的大小，比式 (3) 的「理論無限求和」更貼近實作。
e70ac924270f.en: Equation (4) explicitly uses the kernel's side length $k$ as the upper limit, which pins down the size of the sliding window exactly and is closer to the implementation than the “theoretical infinite sum” of Equation (3).

962848122aab.zh: $I \star K = I * K'$，其中 $K'$ 是把 $K$ 翻轉 180° 的版本。翻個核，兩種運算就可以互換。
962848122aab.en: $I \star K = I * K'$, where $K'$ is $K$ rotated by 180°. Flip the kernel and the two operations become interchangeable.

f5dc4be1cf58.zh: 幾乎所有深度學習框架（PyTorch、TF、JAX）的卷積函式，底層都實作互相關。記憶口訣：「程式不翻核」。
f5dc4be1cf58.en: In almost every deep-learning framework (PyTorch, TF, JAX), the convolution function is implemented as cross-correlation under the hood. Mnemonic: “code doesn't flip the kernel”.

808e229eef50.zh: 為什麼訓練時翻不翻核幾乎沒差？ Why Flipping Doesn't Matter During Training
808e229eef50.en: Why does flipping the kernel or not make almost no difference in training?

32329c94da49.zh: 梯度下降只在乎能不能把損失壓下去
32329c94da49.en: Gradient descent only cares whether it can push the loss down

6e67b620f84e.zh: 訓練神經網路時，核的初始值是隨機的。無論你的框架做的是卷積（翻核）還是互相關（不翻核）：
6e67b620f84e.en: When training a neural network, the kernel's initial values are random. Whether your framework computes convolution (flipped kernel) or cross-correlation (unflipped kernel):

7e0e5ec802d4.zh: 若堅持翻核，網路就學會「翻過的那一版核」——梯度下降把核學成正確翻轉版本。
7e0e5ec802d4.en: If you insist on flipping the kernel, the network learns “the flipped version of the kernel”: gradient descent learns the kernel as the correct flipped version.

b33cab5caf48.zh: 若不翻，網路就學會「沒翻的那一版核」——梯度下降把核學成正確未翻版本。
b33cab5caf48.en: If you don't flip, the network learns “the unflipped version of the kernel”: gradient descent learns the kernel as the correct unflipped version.

c9b8902b2f28.zh: 兩者學到的核是彼此的180° 旋轉版，但對損失函式的最終效果完全相同。
c9b8902b2f28.en: The two learned kernels are 180° rotations of each other, but their final effect on the loss function is exactly the same.

c9f68e96aa59.zh: 卷積 = 翻核再滑著乘加（理論定義，訊號處理的嚴謹版）
c9f68e96aa59.en: Convolution = flip the kernel, then slide, multiply and add (the theoretical definition, the rigorous signal-processing version)

e78efba5daf9.zh: CNN 框架多半省略翻轉、改做互相關（效能等同，命名混淆）
e78efba5daf9.en: CNN frameworks mostly skip the flip and compute cross-correlation instead (equally effective, confusingly named)

b4ddf9bca4ab.zh: 反正 backprop 會把核學成對的方向，翻不翻核不影響最終結果
b4ddf9bca4ab.en: Either way, backprop learns the kernel in the right orientation, so flipping or not does not affect the final result

b30ed755e259.zh: 這就像用左手還是右手寫字：習慣不同，但只要練習充分，最終都能寫出漂亮的字。梯度下降是那個「充分練習」的過程，無論慣例如何，都能找到正確的核。 It's like writing with your left or right hand — different convention, same final result given enough practice. Gradient descent is that practice: it finds the correct kernel regardless of the flip convention.
b30ed755e259.en: It's like writing with your left hand or your right hand: the habit differs, but with enough practice both end up writing beautifully. Gradient descent is that “enough practice”: whatever the convention, it finds the correct kernel.

7fba50328949.en: CNN frameworks colloquially call it “convolution” but the code computes cross-correlation, and gradient descent adapts to the convention automatically.

5c493363f024.zh: 題目 1：式 (2) 中 $w[t-a]$ 相對於把核直接寫成 $w[t+a]$，凸顯的理論步驟是？
5c493363f024.en: Question 1: In Equation (2), compared with writing the kernel directly as $w[t+a]$, which theoretical step does $w[t-a]$ highlight?

d67a45bd0b65.zh: A. 將核沿時間軸平移到位置 $t$
d67a45bd0b65.en: A. Shifting the kernel along the time axis to position $t$

eb802fa65617.zh: B. 將核沿軸翻轉再平移（$-a$ 代表翻轉，$t$ 代表平移）
eb802fa65617.en: B. Flipping the kernel along the axis and then shifting it ($-a$ stands for the flip, $t$ for the shift)

631df6472de4.zh: C. 對核做正規化（normalize）使總和為 1
631df6472de4.en: C. Normalizing the kernel so that it sums to 1

51ac0f056ee7.zh: D. 將輸入訊號翻轉，讓核保持不動
51ac0f056ee7.en: D. Flipping the input signal while the kernel stays fixed

b87970db67f3.zh: 題目 2：二維影像卷積式 (3) 中 $K[i-m, j-n]$ 的下標為何有減法？
b87970db67f3.en: Question 2: Why does the index $K[i-m, j-n]$ in the 2-D image convolution of Equation (3) contain subtractions?

1113d6aa4432.zh: A. 代表從右到左、從下到上地遍歷影像畫素
1113d6aa4432.en: A. It means the image pixels are traversed right to left and bottom to top

ea6d304c0c4f.zh: B. 因為理論卷積要先翻核才做點積（$i-m$ 和 $j-n$ 分別在兩個維度做翻轉）
ea6d304c0c4f.en: B. Because theoretical convolution flips the kernel before taking the dot product ($i-m$ and $j-n$ flip the two dimensions respectively)

78574c00653d.zh: C. 下標的減法只是防止陣列越界的一種技巧
78574c00653d.en: C. The subtraction in the index is just a trick to avoid out-of-bounds array access

e111189626c9.zh: D. 是互相關的定義，不是卷積的定義
e111189626c9.en: D. It is the definition of cross-correlation, not of convolution

2e2905c4d2f7.zh: 題目 3：實務 CNN 函式庫（如 PyTorch 的 F.conv2d）通常執行的是？
2e2905c4d2f7.en: Question 3: What do practical CNN libraries (such as PyTorch's F.conv2d) usually compute?

20f12cb172be.zh: A. 真正的離散卷積（先翻核 180° 再做點積）
20f12cb172be.en: A. True discrete convolution (flip the kernel by 180°, then take the dot product)

6db5f9da0c61.zh: B. 互相關（核不翻，直接滑動做點積）
6db5f9da0c61.en: B. Cross-correlation (the kernel is not flipped; it slides directly and takes dot products)

82984778d98c.zh: C. FFT 頻域卷積（每次都轉到頻域計算）
82984778d98c.en: C. FFT frequency-domain convolution (every computation goes through the frequency domain)

ddc1ba567710.zh: D. 完全自訂核方向，由使用者決定是否翻轉
ddc1ba567710.en: D. A fully custom kernel orientation, where the user decides whether to flip

9721f0ffa608.zh: 題目 4：為什麼訓練時不翻核也能學到有效特徵？
9721f0ffa608.en: Question 4: Why can training learn effective features without flipping the kernel?

75c22c5c8891.zh: A. 因為核的初始值已經預先翻轉過，所以訓練後結果相同
75c22c5c8891.en: A. Because the kernel's initial values are already flipped in advance, so the result after training is the same

aba642ab7585.zh: B. 因為影像處理中的核都是對稱的，翻轉後不會改變
aba642ab7585.en: B. Because kernels in image processing are always symmetric, so flipping changes nothing

3f2d8fc6794d.zh: C. 可學習核會自動適配慣例，梯度下降不在乎有沒有翻（只在乎損失下降）
3f2d8fc6794d.en: C. A learnable kernel adapts to the convention automatically; gradient descent doesn't care whether it is flipped (only whether the loss goes down)

3b5d45a5a806.zh: D. 因為深度學習的損失函式對核的翻轉是不敏感的
3b5d45a5a806.en: D. Because the loss functions of deep learning are insensitive to flipping the kernel
